name: Afrobeat Guitar
description: Guitars for Afrobeat and highlife: a clean archtop through its pickup, the same archtop on its microphone, a palm-muted chop for sixteenth-note scratching, and a guitar-banjo for bright plucked lines.

patches.name: Clean Archtop
patches.note: Archtop guitar, magnetic pickup (Shinyguitar, one-voice program). 4 velocity layers x 4 round robins. The main rhythm and lead guitar.

patches.name: Archtop Mic
patches.note: The same archtop recorded with a microphone (Shinyguitar, blend control at full microphone). Airier and more acoustic, for open chords and fingerpicking.

patches.name: Funk Chop
patches.note: The clean archtop with a fast decay and a darker tone, standing in for a palm-muted string. This is an emulation on the engine side (the pack has no palm-mute samples), so it is best for short chords and scratches.

patches.name: Guitar Banjo
patches.note: SX six-string guitar banjo (Ganjo), 1 velocity layer with round robins. Tuned up to equal temperament from about 40 cents sharp.
